hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in */.claude-plugin/*.json) jq -r --slurpfile mk "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json" '.name as $n | .description as $d | ($mk[0].plugins[] | select(.name==$n)) as $e | if $e == null then "MISSING in marketplace: \($n)" elif $e.description != $d then "DESC DRIFT: \($n)" elif $e.source != "./plugins/\($n)" then "SOURCE DRIFT: \($n)" else empty end' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/plugins/*/.claude-plugin/plugin.json ;; esac
